The Ordinance was read the third time and passed by the following vote
Yeas Alderman Dremond, Cook Diffenbaugh
James, Robinson and Taylor and Mr President Nays None
By Alderman Cook. Be it resolved by
the City Council of the City of Austin. That the Committee on Fire Department and the
Committee on Market house be authorized and empowered to Contract for the removal of the
Fire Alarm bell to the City Market house, or to repair the old Bell tower, whichever in
their Judgement is to the best interest of the City
On Motion the Council Adjourned

John P Herbert
City Clerk

Called Meeting of City Council
Council Chamber Aug 26 1876

The Council was called to order at 12.30 PM T. W. Chandler President of the Board of
Aldermen in the Chair Roll called and the following members answered Aldermen. Cook.
Diffenbaugh. Nordale. James. Robinson and Taylor. Absent Aldermen Dremond, Dormour, and
Shute Quorum present The President informed the council that he had called them together
for the purpose of laying before them a communication from the Chief of Fire Department
relative to the purchase of Engine Hose. [illegible] The following is the communication
received from the Chief of Fire Department

Austin Texas
August 26th 1876

To the
Mayor and Board of Aldermen
of the City of Austin

Gents


 --- Page break --- 

163

Enclosed I hand you proposals from the Gutta Percha Co of New York to furnish Hose to the
City I would respectfully recommend the Boyd Hose to your Honorable body
Yours Respectfully
Jn L Nagle
Chief of Fire Dept

On motion the communication was received
whereupon Alderman Leark introduced the following Resolved that bids be received for the
next thirty days for purchase of 1000 feet of hose said hose to be 2½ inches in diameter
inside and all necessary couplings for the Fire Depa artment, and that all bids be
submitted to the Chief of Fire Department and the Fire Committee, and the lowest and best
bid submitted to said chief and Fire Committee shall be subm mitted to the City Council
for immediate action. All bids re ceived shall be paid in Warrants of the City, and said
bids be advertised in the Statesman for the length of time above mentioned. The resolution
not receiving the required two thirds vote was lost. (See signed Page 2 Rule 8)
By Alderman Robinson. Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin. That the
Fire Committee be authorized to have one Gas Light erected in the Austin Hook & Ladder
House and in the Colorado Engine House. Carried
On motion the Council adjourned . .

Approved Sept. 14 1876 John F Harland
City Clerk
